title: Rust: AST Interpreter
description: Build a tree-walking interpreter that executes AST nodes.

steps.title: Define Value Type
steps.description: Define a `Value` enum: `Number(f64)`, `StringVal(String)`, `Bool(bool)`, `Null`. Implement `Display` for each variant. Print sample values.
hints: `impl Display for Value { fn fmt(&self, f: &mut Formatter) -> fmt::Result { match self { Value::Number(n) => write!(f, "{}", n), ... } } }`

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a Number value.

steps.title: Evaluate Literals
steps.description: Implement `fn eval(node: &ASTNode, env: &mut Environment) -> Result<Value, String>` that evaluates NumberLiteral and Ident (lookup in env). Test with `NumberLiteral(42)` and simple let-binding.
hints: `fn eval(node: &ASTNode, env: &mut HashMap<String, Value>) -> Result<Value, String>`
Ident looks up in env and returns or error if not found.

verification.failureMessage: Evaluate a number literal and print the result.

steps.title: Evaluate Binary Expressions
steps.description: Extend eval to handle BinaryOp nodes. Implement `+`, `-`, `*`, `/` for Number values. Handle division by zero with an error. Evaluate `2 + 3 * 4` and print the result (14).

steps.title: Evaluate Statements
steps.description: Handle Let and Print statements. Let evaluates the expression and stores in env. Print evaluates and prints the value. Execute `"let x = 10; print x * 2"` and verify output.
hints: Let: eval expr, store in env, return Null.

verification.failureMessage: Interpret 'let x = 10; print x * 2' and print 20.

steps.title: Full REPL
steps.description: Create a simple Read-Eval-Print-Loop: tokenize, parse, evaluate, and print the result in a single `run(source: &str)` function. Test with multiple programs: `"print 1 + 2"`, `"let x = 5; print x * x"`.
hints: `fn run(source: &str) { let tokens = tokenize(source); let ast = parse(tokens); let result = eval(ast, &mut env); println!("{:?}", result); }`
The environment persists across multiple runs.
Print the result of each evaluation.

verification.failureMessage: Run multiple programs and print results.
